verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal supporting pipes (help -l | grep command) and Apple Shortcuts automation for scripted, multi-step workflows across files, which implies some capacity for bulk operations, but there is no explicit documentation of loop constructs, wildcard globbing, or batch-processing examples (e.g., renaming/processing many files at once). missing for 10: explicit shell scripting/looping examples, wildcard/glob bulk-file operation documentation, independent evidence of bulk automation in practice.
